           FUCUS VESICULOSUS

         Sea Kelp


A remedy for obesity and   non-toxic goitre  ;
        also exophthalmic. Digestion is furthered and flatulence diminished. Obstinate constipation;
        forehead feels as if compressed by an iron ring. Thyroid enlargement in obese subjects.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Phytol;
        Thyroidine; Badiaga; Iodum  .



Dose.--  Tincture, five to sixty drops three times a day before
        meals.
